description: This script retrieves the version information of the current project/repository by checking for a version file or querying version control systems (git or hg). It supports different revision formats and can determine the current revision, a revision range, or the latest revision hash.

methods.name: try_version
methods.description: Checks for a local 'version' file and reads its content as the revision number.

methods.name: try_git
methods.description: Retrieves the current revision from a git repository using various approach depending on the input pattern.

methods.name: try_hg
methods.description: Retrieves revision information from an hg (Mercurial) repository if present.
